blocks.text: If necessary, Ada Tours may substitute hotels of the same category.
The order of the excursions may change while the tour programme remains the same.
Airport Fast Track and VIP Fast Track at Sugarloaf Mountain are separate services. Airport Fast Track costs extra. VIP Fast Track at Sugarloaf Mountain is included on day 4.
Ada Tours is not responsible for hotel breakfasts missed when you check out early for an early flight or excursion.
5 February: Arrival in Rio and Copacabana Palace

On arrival, an English-speaking guide will meet you with a sign.

You then take a private transfer to the hotel.

On the way, you can already see Rio’s green hillsides, the ocean and the city’s neighbourhoods.

You stay in a Deluxe Ocean View room at Belmond Copacabana Palace, with breakfast included.

The evening is free after your journey.

You can head to the ocean for a walk along Copacabana or spend the evening at the hotel.

We recommend Cipriani.

The Michelin-starred restaurant serves Italian cuisine and offers wine and live piano music.

You can also book Airport Fast Track.

The service includes an aircraft-side welcome, an electric cart, priority clearance through airport formalities, help with check-in and baggage, and porter service.

Airport Fast Track on the first day costs extra.
